title: 猪苗代湖で水上バイク転覆 17歳の高校生死亡 1人意識不明 福島
extracted_text:
3日、福島県の猪苗代湖で男性3人が乗っていた水上バイクが転覆する事故があり、2人が意識のない状態で病院に搬送されました。このうち17歳の高校生の死亡が確認され、警察が事故の詳しい状況を調べています。

translated_text: On the 3rd, an accident occurred in Lake Inawashiro, Fukushima Prefecture, where a jet ski carrying three men overturned. Two people were taken to the hospital in an unconscious state. Among them, a 17-year-old high school student's death was confirmed, and police are investigating the details of the accident.
title_en: Jet Ski Overturns in Lake Inawashiro, Fukushima: 17-Year-Old High School Student Dies, Another Unconscious
